title.zh: SmartLingo V2 第五轮：测评优先与日语离线实景练习
title.en: SmartLingo V2 round five: placement-first onboarding and offline Japanese scenarios

purpose.zh: 让新学员先测评再得到课程起点建议，并在日语咖啡店与杂货店提供可靠的离线点单、购物对话；同时补齐站点专用 AI 密钥存在时的发布同步路径。
purpose.en: Recommend a starting course after placement and provide reliable offline Japanese cafe and grocery exchanges, while adding conditional deployment sync for site-owned AI credentials when available.

zh: 新用户默认选择十五题定位测评，不需先自报等级；仍可明确选择从基础开始或自行选级别，保存计划不会自动启动 Max 试用。
日语咖啡店和杂货店初级各增加十组任务连贯的店员与学员问答，可在无在线 AI 时加载。
沿用 Konectible 已验证的发布代码：仅当 SmartLingo 仓库具有站点专用 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 密钥时才同步至 Worker；密钥值不写入源码、构建或日志。
en: New learners default to a 15-item placement assessment rather than self-reporting a level; fundamentals and manual level selection remain available, and saving a goal never starts a Max trial.
Add ten coherent beginner staff–learner exchanges each for Japanese cafe and grocery scenarios that load without online AI.
Reuse verified Konectible deployment commands to sync only available SmartLingo-owned OpenAI or DeepSeek credentials into Worker secrets, never source or build output.

zh: 影响语言规划页、生活口语日语咖啡店与杂货店初级内容、生产发布流程；价格、支付、既有学习记录和用户资料不变。
en: Affects the language-planning page, beginner Japanese cafe and grocery speaking content, and deployment workflow; prices, checkout, existing learning records, and profiles are unchanged.

zh: 规划页面将起点方式提前，测评路径默认使用免费的初级七日课程承载题目，测评完成后再推荐等级；修复已加入课程列表请求位于过早 return 后的不可达问题。日语新增两组预构建场景；发布流程按 Konectible 的已验证条件同步可用的 AI 密钥。
en: Move starting-point choice ahead of manual courses; use the free seven-day beginner course to host placement, then recommend a level after assessment. Restore the joined-course fetch previously placed after an early return. Add two prebuilt Japanese scenario sets and conditionally sync available AI secrets with the verified Konectible workflow.

zh: 463 项完整测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、生产构建与敏感扫描通过；规划页中英文五种屏宽 WebKit 检查 10/10，通过共享站点契约。
Safari 核对 SmartLingo GitHub Actions 当前没有 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 密钥；密钥同步步骤会跳过，不能据此宣称生产 AI 已恢复。精确提交部署与真实浏览器验收须在推送后执行。
en: All 463 tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, production build, and sensitive scan pass; the planning page passes 10/10 WebKit combinations across Chinese/English and five viewports, and shared-site contracts pass.

Safari confirms that SmartLingo GitHub Actions currently has neither OpenAI nor DeepSeek secrets. Conditional sync therefore skips; it is not evidence of restored production AI. Exact-commit deployment and real-browser acceptance follow publication.

zh: 没有站点专用 AI 密钥时，需 AI 的场景会继续离线兜底；创建可计费新密钥须另行授权并经生产复测。
日语离线覆盖目前仅 2/36 个场景×等级单元，尚未经母语者审校；实时语音和普通付费账号端到端验收未完成。
en: Without a site-owned AI credential, AI-dependent scenarios continue to fall back offline. A new billable credential requires separate authorization and production retesting.
Japanese offline coverage is 2/36 scene–level units and awaits native-speaker review; live voice and ordinary paid-member end-to-end acceptance remain unfinished.

zh: 仅将 Konectible 已验证的可选 AI 密钥同步方式适配 SmartLingo 独立 Cloudflare 流程；日语场景只复用 SmartLingo 既有教学题组结构。
en: Adapt only Konectible's verified optional AI-secret sync to SmartLingo's isolated Cloudflare workflow; Japanese scenes reuse SmartLingo's existing lesson-set structure.

rollback.zh: 本轮没有数据迁移；如需回退，可恢复上一成功发布流程，已同步的现有 Worker 密钥由 Cloudflare 独立保管。
rollback.en: This round has no data migration; revert to the prior successful workflow if needed. Existing Worker secrets remain independently managed by Cloudflare.
